{{Quote|Battles and invasions have been reported in more than a dozen systems. Imperial fleets are being forced to intervene in the Vexta Belt, Entralla, Dactruria, and Tovarskl.|A newscaster, during the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''Vexta Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Vexta system/Legends|Vexta system]] of the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]].
